# CoachEcho Terms of Use

_Effective October 1, 2026_

These Terms of Use ("Terms") apply to your use of the CoachEcho app for iPhone and Apple Watch ("CoachEcho" or the "App"), part of the Core Hermit family of apps. Your license to use the App is granted under Apple's Licensed Application End User License Agreement (https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/) (the "Standard EULA"). These Terms supplement the Standard EULA; if they conflict, the Standard EULA controls to the extent required. By using the App you agree to these Terms.

## 1. What the App does
CoachEcho records coaching sessions, transcribes them, and helps you write and review coaching reports. Transcription and AI features run on your device using Apple's frameworks.

## 2. Recording and consent
You are solely responsible for how you use the App to record people. Before recording, make sure you have every permission the law requires where you coach. Some places require the consent of everyone being recorded. When a player is a child, get consent from a parent or guardian. Don't use the App to record anyone secretly or unlawfully.

## 3. AI-generated content
Reports, summaries, and chat answers are generated automatically by AI and may be inaccurate, incomplete, or misattributed. They don't represent the views of the developer. Every report starts as a draft: **review and edit it before you share it**. AI output is not professional advice. It is not medical, injury, physiotherapy, psychological, or legal advice, and it is not a performance or selection assessment. You are solely responsible for evaluating AI output and for anything you share with players, parents, or others.

## 4. Acceptable use
You agree not to use the App to:
- break any law or infringe anyone's rights, including privacy and recording laws;
- harass, discriminate against, or harm anyone, including minors;
- create or spread misleading content about a person;
- violate Apple's acceptable use requirements for its Foundation Models.

## 5. Your content
You keep all rights to your recordings, notes, and reports. Because everything stays on your device, you are responsible for keeping backups of anything important. The App's export and backup features can help.

## 6. Device resources
Long recordings use significant storage and battery. Transcription and AI features depend on your device, iOS version, language, and whether Apple Intelligence is available and turned on, and may be unavailable on some devices.
